feat: preserve native citations during record and replay (#594)

The existing portable response-level citations cannot preserve all
provider-native fields or which text segment owns each citation when
recording and replaying a multi-part response. This adds native
`annotations` and `citations` arrays to text blocks for OpenAI Responses
and Anthropic Messages respectively.

JSON and SSE capture retain text ownership, indexed events, terminal
snapshots, unknown metadata fields and repeated entries. Replay emits
the corresponding annotation events or citation deltas and completed
JSON metadata. Empty cited text is supported. Existing portable
citations remain available; native block metadata takes precedence for
its provider. Current extended-tool opt-in, namespaces/custom calls,
reasoning and usage are preserved. Uncited recordings keep their
existing representation.

Validation: 1,011 tests pass across eight affected suites, including 55
native-citation cases and mixed extended/default tool-mode recording.
Type checks, build, ESLint, formatting, generated API reports and
package export checks pass. Documentation includes a fixture example.

This extends the public text-block types; the updated `etc/` reports are
included.
